newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish Aug PPI seen rising 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish Aug PPI seen rising 0.1 pct.

text.p: Producer prices are expected to have increased by 0.1 percent in August for a 4.5 percent decline over the past 12-month period, a Reuter poll of 18 analysts found on Monday.
The range of the forecasts was a fall of 0.1 percent to an increase of 0.4 percent, and for a rolling 12-month fall of between 4.2 percent and 4.7 percent in producer prices.
The July producer price index showed a decline of 0.1 percent, for a 12-month drop of 4.3 percent. The PPI rose 0.3 percent in August last year, giving a 12-month increase of 10.4 percent.
Sweden is due to publish its August PPI data at 0800 GMT on September 25.
